translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni LUCAS

content: Dos Intud Moka‑atag to Kotungud ni Disas

Sokkad no allow, to id nonaw si Disas woy id ponudtuu moka‑atag to Moppiyon Dinoggan diyot mgo minuvu no riyot templo, id porani kandin iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis, dos mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises woy dos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio.
Kahi ran ki Disas to, “Ondak kotungud du ka‑ay't langun nid puungan du? Woy ondoy kos id boggoy kikow ka‑ay'n kotungud?”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “To dii ku pa od tovakon kos intud dow, duwon intud ku koniyu.
Iddos kotungud ni Juan to kodboutismu, id pomon bo riyot Monama o riyot minuvu?”
Na, id posisipoy ran kod monnuwon dan idda tod tavak, kahi ran to, “Otid ikahi ki no, ‘Iddos Monama kos id boggoy kandin to kotungud,’ od ikahi sikandin to, ‘Mambot waa kow id pomakoy ki Juan?’
Piru otid ikahi ki no, ‘Minuvu kos id boggoy kandin to kotungud,’ na od lumbahon ki to mgo minuvu to batu taman tod patoy, su id pomakoy ran no propeta en si Juan.”
De‑en mid tavak dan ki Disas to, “Waa koy nokosaddoo ko ingkon idda id pomon.”
Kahin Disas kandan to, “Ko ungketen, dii ku mandad sikiyu od ponudtulan ko ingkon id pomon kos kotungud ku to kodpuung ka‑ay.”
Dos Ponunggelengan Moka‑atag to id Pomursintu to Ubasan

Na id itulan ni Disas to ponunggelengan iddos mgo minuvu, kahi rin to, “Duwon sokkad no minuvu no id pomuwa to ubas diyot kamot din. Nopongnga, id popursintuwan din idda woy mid undiyon sikandin to osson ingod to mouhoy'n timpu.

To timpu ron to kodpomupu to ubas, id suhu rin kos sokkad taddot mgo sudsuhuwon din diyot id pomursintu amoy od angoy to kandin no taad. Piru to kod‑inguma taddot sudsuhuwon din, id pomodasan dan sikandin woy id po‑uli no waa nopiyod.
Na, id suhu mandon taddot komunoy iddos ossa pa no sudsuhuwon din. Piru to id inguma iddos sudsuhuwon dutun, id pomodasan dad en sikandin, id po‑ilawan woy id po‑uli no waa nopiyod.
Id suhu mandon taddot komunoy iddos iko‑otollun sudsuhuwon din, piru to kod‑inguma rin dutun, id poliyan dan sikandin woy id goyod nid poleggua pomon diyot ubasan.
De‑en kohingginawa taddot komunoy to, ‘Ondan pobbo kos od puungan ku? Moppiya pa, ini ron so budtung no anak ku no id dokollan ku to ginawa kos od suhuwon ku, su saddook od rispituwon dan don.’

Piru to nokita taddot id pomursintu no idda ron so anak tat komunoy kos od inguma, id po‑ikohiyoy ran to, ‘Ika ron kos anak to komunoy. Na, od imotayan ta sikandin amoy siketa ron kos od pokokomunoy ka‑ay't ubasan!’
De‑en id goyod dan sikandin nid poleggua pomon diyot ubasan woy id imotayan.” “Na, ondan ayu kos od puungan taddot komunoy to ubasan diyot id pomursintu?
Od undiyonnan din sikandan woy'd imotayan, woy od popursintuwan din to ossa iddos ubasan.” To norinog idda taddot mgo minuvu, mid ikahi sikandan to, “Muopa nanoy no id poporiyu idda to Monama.”
Piru id tongtongngan sikandan ni Disas woy id ikohiyan to, “Na ondan man kos koovottan dow taddot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: ‘Iddos batu no id oovoddan to tohodbovaoy su kunan dan ko waa koru‑anon,
idda vos en kos batu no mosalig no po‑unsaran.’

content: Dos ahad ondoy nod pokovuntug taddon batu, od kotoppuwan woy dos od ko‑uuhan tadda, od koubpot en.”
Dos Intud Moka‑atag to Kodbayad to Buhis

Na, to norinog taddot mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises woy taddot mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis iddos ponunggelengan ni Disas, noovottan dan no sikandan kos id suhat din. De‑en od omotton dan nanoy sikandin to idda ra en no timpu, piru novaakkan dan taddot mo‑uraan minuvu.

Pomon taddon timpu, id nangkap dan to po‑ukit to kod‑ammot ki Disas. Duwon mgo minuvu no id poponi‑id dan kandin nod po‑uvag‑uvag no moppiya kos dontulon. Piru iyon id kopi‑i ran no od sahad si Disas ukit to osengan din, su amoy duwon unayan dan nod uug kandin to saa riyot gubernador no duwon kotungud nod hukum.

Na iddon mgo tohodponi‑id, mid intud ki Disas, kahi ran to, “Tohodnonaw, nokosaddoo koy no bonnaa en kos id oseng woy id nonaw ru. Woy nosorollan doy no ahad ondoy nod isowwon du, id pod‑iling du kos kodnonaw ru, oyyos waa od podmusingon du woy iyon du id nonaw, iddos kovonnaan moka‑atag to id kopi‑it Monama.
De‑en diyot mgo Suhu ni Moises, ollog bo iddos kodbayad to buhis diyot hari to Roma o dii?”
Piru nosorollan ni Disas iddos morat no dontulon dan, de‑en kahi rin to,
“Pokitanna a to soopi to Roma.” To id toyawwan dan si Disas to soopi, id ikahi sikandin to, “Ondoy man bonnong woy ngaran kos od kokita ka‑ay?” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Iddos hari to Roma.”
Kahin Disas to, “Ko ungketen, boggoy row riyot hari to Roma iddos kandin, woy boggoy row riyot Monama iddos kandin.”

Na, waa sikandin nokosahad ahad id kopi‑i ran nanoy nod sahad sikandin ukit to mgo osengan din diyot isowwan to mgo minuvu. Nosoobbuwan dan oraroy taddot tavak din, de‑en nokopo‑onong‑onong dan dobbo.
Dos Intud Moka‑atag to Kodbadnow taddot id Poomatoy ron
Na, duwon mgo Saduseo no id porani ki Disas. Inin mgo minuvu, konnod pomakoy nod bodnawon to Monama iddos id poomatoy ron.

Kahi ran to, “Tohodnonaw, nosulat diyot mgo Suhu ni Moises no otik duwon mama nod patoy no waa anak dan taddot sawa rin, ko‑ilangan no od pomoowwon idda to suwod din amoy'd poko‑anak dan atag taddot id patoy.
Ponunggeleng, duwon pittun toosuwod. Dos kinokokayan, id osawa piru id patoy no waa anak.
Na, id pomau taddot iko‑oruwon suwod din iddos ba‑ay. Id patoy mandad sikandin no waa anak.
Ungketen dad en mandad kos notomanan taddot iko‑otollun suwod taman to iko‑pittu, id poomatoy ran langun no waa anak.
Diyot mori, id patoy mandad iddos ba‑ay.
Na, init allow to kodbadnow taddot id poomatoy ron, ondoy musing kandan kos tullid no sawa taddot ba‑ay? Su iddos langun tat pittun toosuwod, noko‑osawa man kandin.”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Ka‑ay to ampow't ingod, od po‑osoway kos mgo minuvu.
Piru iddos ahad ondoy no ollog nod bodnawon to Monama woy'd lonug kandin diyot datas to langit, dii ron od po‑osoway.
Dii ron mandad sikandan od poomatoy, oyyos od poko‑iling don sikandan to mgo ponolihan. Mgo anak don sikandan to Monama su id badnow rin man.

Na moka‑atag taddot mgo minuvu no id poomatoy ron, ahad si Moises, id posivonnaa nod bodnawon en sikandan to Monama. Su iddot mid pokita kandin iddos Monama riyot id loglog no sopinit, id ngoranan din iddos od Longaggon no, ‘Monama ni Abraham, ni Isaac woy ni Jacob.’ Na, ungketen kos no‑ikahi ahad nouhoy ron id poomatoy onsi Abraham.

De‑en pomon ka‑ay, od kosorollan ta, no od kovadnow en iddos poomatoy ron, oyya su iddos Monama, konna sikandin Monama taddot id poomatoy ron, ko konna, Monama taddot nongo‑uyag. Su riyot kod‑ontong din, nongo‑uyag kos langun.”
Na kahi taddot dumon tohodnonaw to mgo Suhu ni Moises to, “Tohodnonaw, ollog en kos tavak du.”
Pomon tadda, worad od poko‑aku nod intud ki Disas.
Dos Intud Moka‑atag to Mesiyas
Na mid intud si Disas kandan, kahi rin to, “Mambo man tid ikahi to mgo minuvu no lubbad ni Harin David iddos Mesiyas?
Oyyos si David don en kos id oseng diyot libru to mgo Salmo no mid ungketen to,

content.text: ‘Mid ikahi iddos Monama riyon tod Longaggon ku no,
Unsad ka lomig to kowanan ku,
taman tod kotalu kud iddos od pongkuntra kikow.’

content: Na, su id oseng man ni David no Longaggon din iddos Mesiyas, de‑en konna ra sikandin lubbad ni David, ko konna, Longaggon din mandad.”
Dos Pomandu ni Disas no od Bantoy taddot mgo Tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises
Laggun tid pominog iddos mo‑uraan minuvu, id ikohiyan ni Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan din to,

“Bantoy kow taddot mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises no od kotoosan nod oumpak to mowwet woy'd pokitakita. Id kopi‑i ran nod kumustan woy od rispituwon diyot od kolivuungan to mgo minuvu. Otik diyon sikandan to simba‑an to mgo Judio o riyot pista, id kopi‑i ran nod unsad diyot mgo unsaran no id panoy atag taddot od rispituwon no mgo minuvu.

Id okalan dan iddos mgo ba‑ay'n bau amoy'd ka‑ahaw ran iddos koruwonnan dan. Woy amoy od kotombunan kos morat no pinuungan dan, od poowetton dan kos dosalon dan no uvag kun to moppiya sikandan no mgo minuvu. Purisu lampas en no moka‑arat‑arat iddos silut to Monama kandan.”
